pages.text: The $(thing)Pale Garden$() grows where Dark Forests are deep and quiet. Its pale oaks hide $(item)Creaking Hearts$(). At night the heart wakes and calls a $(thing)Creaking$(), which only moves while nobody is looking at it. It can't be hurt while its heart lives: break the heart to end it.
pages.title: Pale Garden

pages.text: $(item)Eyeblossoms$() open at night and close by day. Pale moss carpets the floor and hangs from the trees.
The $(thing)Dappled Forest$() is full of red, orange and yellow poplars, with shelf mushrooms on their trunks and red shrubs below.
pages.title: Dappled Forest

pages.text: $(thing)Sulfur Caves$() lie under some Dripstone Caves: yellow stone, sulfur spikes and $(thing)Sulfur Cubes$(). A small cube can be scooped up in a bucket. Feed it a block and it carries it around inside.
pages.title: Sulfur Caves

pages.text: On $(thing)Gallifrey$() itself you can find a $(thing)Gallifreyan Pale Garden$(), whose pale oaks grow red leaves, and $(thing)Gallifreyan Sulfur Caves$() deep below the surface.
